note: Partial result, not a solution to the requested multi-digit task. Added seven layer-17 MLP neurons (six active), totaling 13,440 parameters; all native weights remain unchanged. Closed-form localized gates and analytically constrained output directions repair seven single-digit failures. Exhaustive greedy N1 accuracy improved from 93/100 to 100/100. Final independent practice sample: mean N1–8 accuracy 33.75%, below the required 95%; sampled N2–20 and chat-addition outputs unchanged. Final preservation checks measured exactly zero KL on 480 ordinary-Wikipedia tokens, 640 number-rich tokens, and 494 chat-reply tokens, with zero added-neuron activation. These limited checks support localization, not guaranteed held-out preservation. No improvement is claimed for multi-digit addition; N21–30 were not tested. Details are in work/final_report.json and work/notes.md.
